messages.subject: Black & Veatch Thailand | Power, water and sustainable infrastructure leadership
messages.body:
Dear Black & Veatch Talent and Thailand Leadership Team,

Black & Veatch's work across power, water and sustainable infrastructure, together with current senior project leadership hiring in Bangkok, makes the Thailand platform highly relevant to my background.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical operating experience across energy transition, water and environmental stakeholders, major regulators and cross-functional industrial teams. My recent work includes governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I would complement technical delivery teams with strong country, institutional and stakeholder execution.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or country leadership. I have attached a Black & Veatch Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
